title: migrate() unbounded per-unit mint loop causes gas DoS for large V1 holders
description: migrate() (NFTMigrator.sol:62) reads the caller's full V1 ERC1155 balance per index (balanceOf(msg.sender, i) at line 66) and then runs an inner loop 'for (j = 0; j < balance; j++) v2.mintFor(v2Index, msg.sender)' (lines 70-72), performing one external _mint per unit held. There is no batch mintFor and no pagination: migrate() processes the caller's entire balance in a single transaction.
impact: No direct asset loss. V1 NFTs retain their original utility and migrate() burns-then-re-mints atomically. Impact is unavailability of the migration path for any holder whose aggregate V1 ERC1155 balance at a single index is large enough that 'balance' sequential v2.mintFor calls exceed the block gas limit, leaving that holder permanently unable to migrate with no in-contract workaround (no paginated/partial migrate path).
attackPath: 1. A user legitimately accumulates a large balance of a single V1 index (NFTMigrator.sol:66 reads IERC1155.balanceOf(msg.sender, i)).
3. The inner loop 'for (j = 0; j < balance; j++) v2.mintFor(v2Index, msg.sender)' (lines 70-72) performs one external _mint per unit held.
4. There is no batch mintFor and no pagination; migrate() processes the caller's ENTIRE balance in a single transaction.
5. For a sufficiently large balance, the cumulative gas exceeds the block gas limit and migrate() always reverts, leaving the holder permanently unable to migrate.
likelihood: medium - requires a holder to have accumulated a large single-index balance; no special privilege needed (permissionless availability issue, balance is not owner-controlled).
assumptions: A V1 holder's single-index balance is large enough that 'balance' sequential ERC1155 _mint operations exceed the block gas limit.
externalRequirements: None beyond ordinary block gas limits.
recommendation: Add a paginated/partial migration path (e.g. migrate a bounded number of units per call, or accept a maxCount parameter and resume), or expose a batch mintFor that mints N units in a single ERC1155 _mintBatch-style call so per-unit gas does not scale with balance. Ensure the burn is also partial/idempotent so a holder can drain a large balance across multiple transactions.
justification: Protocol function (migration) becomes unavailable for affected holders with no in-contract workaround. Assets are not directly at risk because V1 NFTs are unaffected and remain usable, so this caps at Medium per C4 (function/availability impacted, no asset theft). Not High: no asset loss or theft, V1 utility retained.
borderlineFlag: BORDERLINE for severity-auditor: depends on whether realistic single-index balances can plausibly reach the gas ceiling. If realistic max balance per index is small (e.g. capped supply per dispatcher), this collapses toward Low/QA (merely expensive, not a brick). If some V1 indexes have large per-holder balances, Medium is firm. Confirm realistic balance distribution and per-_mint gas cost.
